name: snowman-intl-tools
description: CLDR 48.0 data for the Intl generators: supplemental data node does not expose (cldr-core: aliases, likely subtags, plural rules; cldr-bcp47: BCP 47 keys), the date patterns and names (cldr-dates-full), and Unicode 17.0 segmentation properties. Other locale display data comes from node's own Intl (ICU 78, CLDR 48.0).
